_comment: Members who did not fill in the sign-up form, but told an officer their details and said yes to being listed. scripts/build_members.py merges these with the form's answers. Fields: name (as they want it shown), year, major, school (leave out if CMU), since (the year they joined), bio, insta, and photos: the file names of their pictures in images/members/originals/. 'secret' is optional: it turns one word of their bio into a quiet link that opens a photo full-size, the way the word "beans" works on Preston's card. If someone here later fills in the form, their own answers win and you can delete them from this file.
